def improve(weights, edges, stages, depth, ratio):
    import random
    import time
    start = time.perf_counter()
    n = len(weights)
    best = list(stages)
    if n < 2 or depth < 2:
        return best
    s = best[:]
    pred = [[] for _ in weights]
    succ = [[] for _ in weights]
    coef = [0] * n
    for u, v, w in edges:
        if u != v:
            succ[u].append(v)
            pred[v].append(u)
            coef[u] -= w
            coef[v] += w
    loads = [0] * depth
    for u, w in enumerate(weights):
        loads[s[u]] += w
    comm = sum(coef[u] * s[u] for u in range(n))
    peak = max(loads)
    square = sum(x*x for x in loads)
    best_value = ratio * peak + comm
    pending = {}
    rng = random.Random(0)
    tick = 0
    elapsed = 0.0
    while True:
        if tick % 128 == 0:
            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
            if elapsed >= 8.5:
                break
        tick += 1
        # Finish with direct objective descent; earlier phases balance loads.
        objective_mode = elapsed > 6.5 or int(elapsed / 1.3) % 3 == 2 or ratio == 0
        def key(p, q, c):
            return (ratio*p+c, q) if objective_mode else (p, q, c)
        current = key(peak, square, comm)
        chosen = None
        tops = sorted(range(depth), key=loads.__getitem__, reverse=True)[:3]
        u = rng.randrange(n)
        a = s[u]
        wu = weights[u]
        if tick % 3:
            lo = max((s[v] for v in pred[u]), default=0)
            hi = min((s[v] for v in succ[u]), default=depth-1)
            for b in range(lo, hi+1):
                if b == a:
                    continue
                x, y = loads[a]-wu, loads[b]+wu
                other = next((loads[t] for t in tops if t != a and t != b), 0)
                p = max(x, y, other)
                q = square + x*x + y*y - loads[a]**2 - loads[b]**2
                c = comm + coef[u]*(b-a)
                k = key(p, q, c)
                if k < current:
                    current = k
                    chosen = (p, q, c, ((u, b),))
        else:
            v = rng.randrange(n)
            b = s[v]
            if a == b:
                continue
            delta = weights[v]-wu
            x, y = loads[a]+delta, loads[b]-delta
            other = next((loads[t] for t in tops if t != a and t != b), 0)
            p = max(x, y, other)
            q = square + x*x + y*y - loads[a]**2 - loads[b]**2
            c = comm + (coef[u]-coef[v])*(b-a)
            if key(p, q, c) >= current:
                continue
            # Check both moved vertices using their simultaneous new stages.
            if any((a if t == v else s[t]) > b for t in pred[u]):
                continue
            if any((a if t == v else s[t]) < b for t in succ[u]):
                continue
            if any((b if t == u else s[t]) > a for t in pred[v]):
                continue
            if any((b if t == u else s[t]) < a for t in succ[v]):
                continue
            chosen = (p, q, c, ((u, b), (v, a)))
        if chosen is None:
            continue
        peak, square, comm, moves = chosen
        for u, b in moves:
            loads[s[u]] -= weights[u]
            loads[b] += weights[u]
            s[u] = b
            pending[u] = b
        value = ratio*peak + comm
        if value < best_value:
            for u, b in pending.items():
                best[u] = b
            pending.clear()
            best_value = value
    return best
